title: Website analytics and privacy information
description: Learn how optional Vector OS website analytics works, manage analytics consent and read the current pre-release product privacy information.
html:
Product information

Privacy information

Your work deserves clear boundaries.

Optional website analytics

Vector OS uses Google Analytics only after you allow analytics. It measures visits to public website pages and basic browser and device information. Analytics cookies identify a browser across visits; advertising personalization and Google signals are disabled.

We send page paths without query strings or fragments. Account pages, workspace messages, project files and payment details are excluded. Automatic form, outbound-link and embedded-video measurement are disabled.

Your analytics choice is saved in this browser. You can reject analytics or withdraw permission at any time through Analytics preferences in the footer. Withdrawing permission stops further page-view tracking and removes this site’s Google Analytics cookies. Google processes previously collected information under its own retention settings and policies.

Read how Google uses information from sites that use its services. For questions about this website, contact Vector OS.

Product account policy pending
The product-account information below describes a pre-release product. The website analytics notice above applies to this website.

Your local workspace

The intended workspace separates local project files from explicitly selected task context that may be sent for disclosed AI processing. Exact storage, remote metadata and retention boundaries require qualification; do not assume that all processing or account data stays local.

Website and recorded media

Website and media requests disclose network information to hosting providers. Provider processing and retention must be confirmed in the final customer notice.

Waitlist information

The existing waitlist collects the details and consent you submit for requested project updates. It is separate from a product account. See the notice beside the waitlist form.

Payment information

Monthly subscriptions use Stripe-hosted checkout. Stripe collects your checkout email and payment details under its own privacy notice; no Vector OS website sign-in is required. Account privacy notices will be updated before account enrollment opens.
